eyebrow: Rooted in Baton Rouge real estate since 1979
headline: Your local real estate office.
intro: Gaspard & Co Real Estate is a group of experienced agents who live and work in this part of Baton Rouge. Buying, selling, or just wondering what your home is worth, we'd be glad to help.

why.heading: Local roots since 1979
why.text: Our agents have been helping people buy and sell homes around Baton Rouge for decades. We know the neighborhoods because we live and work in them.

why.heading: The right agent for you
why.text: Teams and independent agents with different styles, all in one office. Tell us what you need and we'll match you with someone who fits.

why.heading: Every step handled
why.text: Pricing, showings, offers, inspections and closing. We keep you informed and take as much stress out of the move as we can.

why.heading: Close to home
why.text: Our agents live all over this part of town, and the office is a short drive away. Call and talk to a real person, or stop by. No call centers and no online guesses.

hours_text: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
